title: Vigorous Crisp Norwegian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and adventurous Norwegian dish featuring tender beef and crisp vegetables in a rich unsalted beef stock, perfect for a cold winter's night. This stew is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and free from excessive spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onions, celery, and garlic to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot, stirring to combine.
Pour in the unsalted beef stock, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the thyme and season the stew with salt and black pepper.
Increase the heat to high and cook, uncovered, until the stew has reached a vigorous boil and the vegetables are crisp, about 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
